blocks: The meeting commemorating the 160th anniversary of the birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen was held solemnly in the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on the morning of the 12th. Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the state and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, delivered an important speech stressing that all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad must unite more closely, carry on Dr Sun Yat-sen's unfinished cause, work together with one heart for the great undertaking of the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation, and keep turning the great dream that the people of all our ethnic groups have pursued since modern times into a beautiful reality.
Members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang and Li Xi attended the meeting.

The atmosphere in the auditorium of the Great Hall of the People was solemn and warm. Above the rostrum hung the banner "Meeting Commemorating the 160th Anniversary of the Birth of Dr Sun Yat-sen"; at the centre of the backdrop was a portrait of Dr Sun Yat-sen, with the dates "1866–2026" below it, and ten red flags stood on either side.
At 10 a.m. the meeting began. All rose and sang the national anthem.

Amid warm applause, Xi Jinping delivered an important speech. He said that Dr Sun Yat-sen was a great national hero, a great patriot and a great forerunner of China's democratic revolution, who fought his whole life to remake China, made outstanding contributions to the Chinese people and the Chinese nation, and is sincerely revered by all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad.

Xi Jinping pointed out that Chinese Communists are the most steadfast supporters, the most loyal partners and the most faithful successors of Dr Sun Yat-sen's revolutionary cause. Over more than 100 years our Party has led the people to great achievements in the new-democratic revolution, in socialist revolution and construction, in reform, opening up and socialist modernization, and in socialism with Chinese characteristics for a new era, writing the most magnificent epic in the thousands of years of the Chinese nation's history. All of this can fully comfort the spirit of Dr Sun Yat-sen.

Xi Jinping stressed that for more than 100 years Dr Sun Yat-sen's call to "rejuvenate China" has inspired generation after generation of Chinese and has continually been given new meaning for its time. Today, the best way to commemorate Dr Sun Yat-sen is to learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit, and to keep advancing the great cause of building a strong country and national rejuvenation.

Xi Jinping pointed out that Dr Sun Yat-sen loved his country and strove to save it all his life, and that to learn from, carry on and carry forward his precious spirit we must hold high the spirit of patriotism and strive to make the motherland prosperous and strong. On the new journey we must uphold the unity of loving the country, loving the Party and loving socialism, uphold the Party's overall leadership and the centralized, unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, and inspire all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad to deepen their love of country and temper their resolve to make it strong, together making our great motherland ever better.

Xi Jinping stressed that Dr Sun Yat-sen cared for the common people all his life, and that to learn from his spirit we must always put the people first and serve them wholeheartedly. On the new journey we must remember that the country is its people and the people are the country; stand firmly on the people's side, grasp their wishes, respect their creativity and pool their wisdom; develop whole-process people's democracy; ensure and improve people's livelihoods; and take solid steps toward the all-round development of the person and common prosperity for all.

Xi Jinping pointed out that Dr Sun Yat-sen pursued truth all his life, and that to learn from his spirit we must adhere to the "two integrations" and keep advancing theoretical innovation on the basis of practice. On the new journey we must be bold in theoretical exploration and innovation, give scientific answers to the questions of China, of the world, of the people and of the times, keep enriching and developing the Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as times change, and keep writing new chapters in adapting Marxism to the Chinese context and the needs of our times.

Xi Jinping stressed that Dr Sun Yat-sen was indomitable all his life, and that to learn from his spirit we must be bold in tackling difficulties and open new frontiers through tenacious struggle. On the new journey we must take into account both the domestic and international situations, coordinate development and security, carry forward the fighting spirit and strengthen our ability to struggle, stand ready to withstand the major tests of high winds and choppy waters and even stormy seas, overcome every risk and challenge on the road ahead, and keep winning new victories in the great struggle of the new era.

Xi Jinping pointed out that Dr Sun Yat-sen championed unity all his life, and that to learn from his spirit we must uphold the united front and keep consolidating and developing the great unity of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation. On the new journey we must unite all forces that can be united, mobilize all positive factors that can be mobilized, promote harmony in relations between political parties, ethnic groups, religions, social strata, and compatriots at home and abroad, consolidate and develop the broadest patriotic united front, and build a mighty force for advancing Chinese modernization.

Xi Jinping stressed that Dr Sun Yat-sen had the whole world in mind all his life, and that to learn from his spirit we must vigorously promote the common values of humanity and actively help build a community with a shared future for mankind. On the new journey we must always keep the future and destiny of humanity in view, understand and handle our relations with the outside world correctly in light of the great trends of human development, the great pattern of change in the world and the great history of China's development, actively advance the implementation of the four global initiatives, and make China's contribution to building a community with a shared future for mankind.

Xi Jinping pointed out that Dr Sun Yat-sen always firmly upheld national unity and ethnic solidarity and resolutely opposed all words and deeds that would split the country or divide the nation. His strong wish and firm will for the reunification of the motherland have always enlightened, educated and inspired all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation. Resolving the Taiwan question and achieving the complete reunification of the motherland is a historic task to which the Communist Party of China is unswervingly committed, the shared aspiration of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation, and an inevitable requirement for realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Compatriots on both sides of the Strait and all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation at home and abroad must join hands to oppose "Taiwan independence" separatist forces together and to work together for the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations and the complete reunification of the motherland.

Presiding over the meeting, Wang Huning said that General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech deeply honoured Dr Sun Yat-sen's immortal contributions to national independence, social progress and the people's happiness; reviewed and summed up the great achievements Chinese Communists have created by carrying on Dr Sun Yat-sen's unfinished cause and uniting and leading the people of all ethnic groups in unremitting struggle; set out clear requirements for learning from, carrying on and carrying forward Dr Sun Yat-sen's precious spirit and inspiring all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation to unite and strive for building a strong country and national rejuvenation through Chinese modernization; and called on compatriots on both sides of the Strait and Chinese at home and abroad to work together for the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations and the complete reunification of the motherland. He said the speech is strongly political, theoretical and instructive, and that we must study it deeply and implement it well, unite more closely around the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, and form a powerful collective force of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation thinking as one and working as one to realize the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

Members of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and members of the Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee who are in Beijing, Vice Chairpersons of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, State Councillors, the President of the Supreme People's Court, the Procurator-General of the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and Vice Chairpersons of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference attended the meeting.

About 3,000 people took part, including principal responsible officials of central Party, government, military and mass-organization departments and of Beijing Municipality; leaders of the central committees of the democratic parties and of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and representatives of people without party affiliation; members of the NPC Standing Committee in Beijing and some NPC deputies; members of the CPPCC National Committee Standing Committee in Beijing and some CPPCC members; representatives of ethnic and religious circles and of relevant social organizations; some foreign envoys to China; representatives of Dr Sun Yat-sen's relatives; representatives of relevant figures from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and overseas guests; representatives of people from all walks of life in the capital; and representatives of officers and soldiers of units stationed in Beijing.
Before the meeting, Xi Jinping and other leaders warmly received representatives of Dr Sun Yat-sen's relatives and overseas guests.
